newsitem.title: RUSSIA: GM, Valmet, AvtoVAZ plan Russian car pla.
newsitem.headline: GM, Valmet, AvtoVAZ plan Russian car pla.

text.p: A group of carmakers led by General Motors subsidiary Adam Opel AG, Finland's Valmet Oy Automotive and Russia's AvtoVAZ have agreed a plan to build a $60 million car plant in north-west Russia, the group said on Wednesday.

"The first step in the plan is to build in the north-western part of Russia a new western-technology car assembly plant with production beginning at the end of 1998 at a capacity of some 30-50,000 cars a year," they said in a statement.
